name: print-social-moment-of-evolution-tech-posts-teal-purple-glitch-vr
title: 'Moment of Evolution, Explore the Future' tech pack in teal-purple with glitchy dot-grid VR photos
whatItIs: Nine square posts on teal-to-purple gradients with photos of a person in a VR headset and jacket, a fine dot-grid glitch texture, split-colour headlines ('moment of evolution', 'Explore the future') mixing purple and white, and small corner logo details.
whatItMeans: Futuristic and immersive; the glitch dot texture over moody VR photography sells 'the future' as something already arriving.
techniques: Overlay a fine dot-grid glitch texture on photos.
Split headline words across two colours for emphasis.
Vary crop and framing of the same photo subject across posts.

vocabulary.definition: Visual noise or distortion mimicking digital error.
A headline where different words use different colours.
